Fn-Nginx Nginx core build provenance

Nginx version: 1.30.4
Source archive: https://nginx.org/download/nginx-1.30.4.tar.gz

Build release: nginx-core-1.30.4-r2
Release asset: nginx-1.30.4-aarch64-linux-static
Binary SHA-256: 78736e949b5efbda202c320de48016a0736a869d7364eb45044a030392fd0475

Build environment:
- Alpine Linux 3.21
- musl libc 1.2.5-r11
- GCC 14.2.0-r4
- OpenSSL 3.3.7-r0
- PCRE 8.45-r3
- zlib 1.3.2-r0

Compiled defaults:
- user: nobody
- group: nogroup

The executable is a stripped, statically linked ELF binary. It was compiled
from the official nginx.org source with the same configure arguments used for
the x86_64 build. No third-party Nginx module is included.
